interpretation.accepted: human-accepted anchor for this exact body and local family context
interpretation.uncertain: not certified; optional quickReason describes uncertainty but creates no global rule
interpretation.rejected: local negative example only; never a global morph/slider bound
interpretation.hiddenRepeats: used only to estimate reviewer consistency; repeat status was hidden in the UI
interpretation.blindQueue: generation kind, family, direction and source anchor were hidden and constrained-shuffled before review
interpretation.phase1Seed: body-bank-phase1-audit-seed-v1.json preserves the completed phase-1 audit and the user follow-up that all uncertain bodies looked too long-legged
interpretation.shapeMetrics: exact shape-dependent Anny rest-rig + rest-mesh bbox only; designed to quantify leg/torso proportions without phase-1 circumference proxies
interpretation.adultStature: every displayed adult is hard-checked at <=205 cm exact rest-mesh stature
interpretation.motionContext: pose/animation is shared by both viewports; two independent camera contexts are stored per rating
interpretation.cameraRule: BANK-only dual viewport; A/B share the viewer area outside the menu, each camera persists independently; optional AutoFit per viewport normalizes apparent body size on body changes
interpretation.headModel: head-size/head-fat coupling is not part of this audit and remains deferred
